mapper.update: update iot_product set metadata = CASE -- 如果metadata为NULL或空对象，初始化基础结构 WHEN metadata IS NULL OR metadata = '{}' OR metadata = '' THEN CASE #{type} WHEN 'properties' THEN JSON_OBJECT('properties', JSON_ARRAY(CAST(#{jsonStr} AS JSON)), 'events', JSON_ARRAY(), 'functions', JSON_ARRAY()) WHEN 'events' THEN JSON_OBJECT('properties', JSON_ARRAY(), 'events', JSON_ARRAY(CAST(#{jsonStr} AS JSON)), 'functions', JSON_ARRAY()) WHEN 'functions' THEN JSON_OBJECT('properties', JSON_ARRAY(), 'events', JSON_ARRAY(), 'functions', JSON_ARRAY(CAST(#{jsonStr} AS JSON))) END -- 如果对应的数组字段不存在，初始化该字段 WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(metadata, #{path}) IS NULL THEN JSON_SET(metadata, #{path}, JSON_ARRAY(CAST(#{jsonStr} AS JSON))) -- 如果ID已存在，覆盖更新 WHEN JSON_SEARCH(metadata, 'one', #{oldId}, null, #{path}) IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_SET(metadata, REPLACE(REPLACE(JSON_SEARCH(metadata, 'one', #{oldId}, null, #{path}), '"', ''), '.id', ''), CAST(#{jsonStr} AS JSON)) -- 否则追加到数组 ELSE JSON_ARRAY_APPEND(metadata, #{path}, CAST(#{jsonStr} AS JSON)) END where product_key = #{productKey}
